newsitem.title: USA: Southwall sees Q2 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Southwall sees Q2 below expectations.

text.p: Southwall Technologies Inc said Thursday that it expects its results for its second quarter ending June 29 to be below expectations.
Wall Street had been expecting the company to report second quarter earnings of $0.12 a share, according to First Call.

The company said it had expected an upswing in seasonal demand for its Heat Mirror window films, but that softness in new housing construction and high inventories delayed the seasonal increase it normally experiences.

"Heat Mirror sales so far this year have been flat with 1996. Unfortunately, we counted on growth in Heat Mirror to help offset increased scale up costs of our new products for the automotive market and start-up of our new facility in Tempe, Arizona," the company said in a statement Thursday evening.
It said however that orders for automotive and anti-reflective films exceed its current production capacity and that it is addressing the capacity constraints at its Tempe plant.

"We feel strongly that this is a temporary set back to our continued earnings growth and that Heat Mirror window films will resume growth, and our new products and capacity expansion for manufacture of our anti-reflective films will assure solid growth in the future," the company said.
